project: SISO - Agrupamento Antecipado com Estoque Mantido na Aprovacao
description: Mantem o desconto de estoque atual em propria e transferencia, estende a geracao de NF para pedidos oc na aprovacao (sem baixa de estoque), e antecipa a criacao do agrupamento fase 1 assim que a NF estiver persistida em todos os fluxos (propria, transferencia e oc). Separado passa a ser prioritariamente fast path de etiqueta/ZPL, com fallback para criar agrupamento apenas quando ele ainda nao existir. PRD completo em tasks/prd-pipeline-antecipado-nf-agrupamento.md

userStories.title: Create shared fase-1 agrupamento helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a reusable helper that creates fase-1 agrupamento for a pedido as soon as NF persistence is complete.
acceptanceCriteria: Create criarAgrupamentoFase1(pedidoId) in a shared module
Helper re-fetches the pedido and only proceeds when nota_fiscal_id and chave_acesso_nf are both persisted
Helper checks idempotency and skips when agrupamento_expedicao_id is already valid
Helper reuses or extracts the existing atomic claim pattern from agrupamento-service (pending + siso_claim_pedidos_para_agrupamento) instead of introducing a competing guard
If the atomic claim path is tightened for fase-1, it never writes pending before both NF persistence fields exist

Helper includes the current fase-1 semantics explicitly: create agrupamento, attempt concluirAgrupamento with the same non-fatal posture already used by agrupamento-service, then obterAgrupamento to discover and save expedicao_id
Helper does not fetch etiqueta/ZPL or baixar ZPL
Shared pending recovery is extracted or made callable outside preCriarAgrupamentosEmLote so fase-1 entrypoints can recover stale pending before or during claim
On success, save agrupamento_expedicao_id and expedicao_id
On failure, leave the pedido eligible for future retry
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is the core primitive of the new Ralph. The project is no longer about moving stock timing; it is about making agrupamento happen as soon as NF persistence allows it. The current codebase already uses siso_claim_pedidos_para_agrupamento plus agrupamento_expedicao_id='pending' as the atomic primitive; fase-1 should reuse or extract that pattern, but with the stricter NF-persisted gate required by this PRD and with stale-pending recovery available before separado time.

userStories.title: Call NF generation and fase-1 agrupamento from all approval worker flows
userStories.description: As a developer, I want all approval worker flows — including OC — to generate NF and immediately attempt fase-1 agrupamento after NF persistence. OC gains NF generation but NOT stock deduction at approval time.
acceptanceCriteria: executarSaidaPropria calls criarAgrupamentoFase1 after enriquecerDadosNf
executarSaidaTransferencia calls criarAgrupamentoFase1 after enriquecerDadosNf

Helper invocation is failure-isolated from the worker stock job: agrupamento failure must not throw past the worker path after estoque_lancado or item-level estoque_saida_lancada have already been persisted
If fase-1 cannot run because NF persistence is still incomplete, the worker still completes successfully and leaves the pedido for second-chance entrypoints
Stock deduction behavior in propria and transferencia remains unchanged
executarMarcadoresOnly gains NF generation (via gerarNotaFiscalPedido, idempotent) and enriquecerDadosNf after marcadores, then calls criarAgrupamentoFase1
executarMarcadoresOnly does NOT gain stock deduction — OC stock remains deferred to the Ciclo 2 worker after compras-release
NF generation in executarMarcadoresOnly is failure-isolated from the compra item resolution: if NF fails, the OC flow (aguardando_compra + itens) still proceeds normally
NF generation + enriquecerDadosNf + criarAgrupamentoFase1 run BEFORE resolveCompraItemIds, inside a single try/catch that does not propagate to the compra resolution

enriquecerDadosNf in executarMarcadoresOnly must NOT trigger a status_separacao transition (the conditional eq aguardando_nf guard in enriquecerDadosNf protects this, since the pedido has not been set to aguardando_nf yet at this point)
When executarMarcadoresOnly detects compraDemandas.length === 0 and redirects to propria, the status_separacao should be set to aguardando_separacao (not aguardando_nf) when NF already exists

If NF is generated but chave_acesso_nf is not yet available (NF pending SEFAZ authorization), executarMarcadoresOnly continues to compra item resolution and leaves agrupamento for second-chance entrypoints (webhook, forcar-pendente)
The Ciclo 2 worker (after compras-release) detects the existing NF via gerarNotaFiscalPedido idempotency and skips directly to stock deduction
Worker comments/docstrings are updated to make clear that this Ralph changes NF timing for OC and agrupamento timing for all flows, not estoque timing
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The existing stock behavior is intentionally preserved: propria and transferencia deduct stock at approval; OC defers stock to Ciclo 2 after compras-release. The new behavior for OC is NF generation + agrupamento at approval time, which creates a Tiny reservation but does not deduct saldo. The Ciclo 2 worker detects the existing NF via gerarNotaFiscalPedido idempotency and skips to stock deduction. If NF generation fails for OC, the compra flow proceeds normally and NF will be generated in Ciclo 2.

userStories.title: Create agrupamento when NF persists later outside worker timing
userStories.description: As a system, I want pedidos whose NF persistence happens later to get a second chance to create fase-1 agrupamento without waiting for separado.
acceptanceCriteria: nf-webhook-handler.ts calls criarAgrupamentoFase1 after saving nota_fiscal_id + chave_acesso_nf
The webhook call only happens when both fields are persisted
Webhook response is never blocked by agrupamento creation
webhook-processor.ts NF reconciliation block also calls criarAgrupamentoFase1
NF reconciliation stops writing pendente and preserves the correct aguardando_nf to aguardando_separacao transition semantics (applies to all decisoes including oc)
src/app/api/separacao/forcar-pendente/route.ts calls criarAgrupamentoFase1 after persisting chave_acesso_nf
src/app/api/separacao/[pedidoId]/forcar-pendente/route.ts calls criarAgrupamentoFase1 after persisting chave_acesso_nf
Manual forcar-pendente routes keep response semantics intact and do not fail the admin action because Tiny agrupamento creation failed
The same idempotency/atomic guard protects worker, webhook, reconciliation, and forcar-pendente entrypoints
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This story covers cases where the worker could not create agrupamento because NF persistence was not yet complete. For OC, this includes the case where NF was generated at approval but chave_acesso_nf was not yet available. In this codebase, 'late NF' includes webhook, reconciliation of saved webhook logs, and the admin forcar-pendente routes.

userStories.title: Keep create-vs-label responsibilities explicit at separado time
userStories.description: As a developer, I want separado-time agrupamento processing to preserve the current split between criar agrupamento and recuperar etiqueta, while making the orchestration clearly favor the label fast path.
acceptanceCriteria: preCriarAgrupamentosEmLote remains the fallback primitive for pedidos that still do not have agrupamento_expedicao_id
recarregarEtiquetasFaltantes remains the fast path primitive for pedidos that already have agrupamento_expedicao_id but are missing etiqueta_zpl

Concluir, concluir-oc, retry-etiqueta, and compras-embalagem orchestration all call both the create fallback and the label retry in a deliberate order instead of duplicating create-vs-label logic in multiple places

concluir-oc gains a call to recarregarEtiquetasFaltantes (fire-and-forget) alongside its existing preCriarAgrupamentosEmLote call, so pick OC pedidos with pre-existing agrupamento get their ZPL cached at concluir time
Fallback only attempts agrupamento creation when NF persistence is complete
Pedidos antigos with agrupamento already saved and missing etiqueta continue through the fast path without recriar agrupamento by default
Processing remains idempotent for old pedidos without agrupamento and for retries
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This story preserves the current safety net while making separado primarily about etiqueta/ZPL. The intent is orchestration clarity, not collapsing preCriarAgrupamentosEmLote and recarregarEtiquetasFaltantes into one opaque primitive. concluir-oc today only calls preCriarAgrupamentosEmLote (which will be a no-op when agrupamento exists). It needs recarregarEtiquetasFaltantes to complete the fast path: bipar → concluir → etiqueta pronta.

userStories.title: Make reroute invalidation explicit for early agrupamento
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the encaminhar flow to explicitly preserve NF while clearing downstream shipping artifacts so early agrupamento remains safe under reroute.
acceptanceCriteria: src/app/api/separacao/encaminhar/route.ts continues preserving nota_fiscal_id and chave_acesso_nf on reroute
The reset payload explicitly clears agrupamento_expedicao_id, expedicao_id, etiqueta_url, etiqueta_zpl, and etiqueta_status
Route comments and/or logging make clear that reroute invalidates downstream shipping artifacts but not NF
Stock reversal behavior remains unchanged
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: The route already clears these fields today; this story turns that behavior into an explicit maintained contract under the new earlier agrupamento timing.

userStories.title: Update docs and validation matrix for agrupamento-only scope
userStories.description: As a technical team, we want the documentation to make clear that this Ralph changes agrupamento timing but deliberately keeps stock timing intact.
acceptanceCriteria: Update docs/architecture-and-flows.md, docs/api-reference-complete.md, and docs/fluxos-siso.md
Document explicitly that propria and transferencia still deduct stock at approval time and that OC now generates NF at approval but defers stock to Ciclo 2
Document the new behavior: NF generation extends to OC at approval time and fase-1 agrupamento runs as soon as NF persistence is complete through the shared guarded helper across all three decisoes

Document that worker integration is failure-isolated from stock-posting success, that NF generation failure in OC does not block compra item resolution, and that late-NF paths include webhook, reconciliation, and both forcar-pendente routes
Document fast path plus fallback at separado without collapsing the current create-vs-label split

Define a minimum executable validation matrix covering helper failure after stock posting, stale pending recovery, late NF via webhook, late NF via forcar-pendente, old pedido with agrupamento already existing but missing etiqueta, rerouted pedido after early agrupamento, OC approval generating NF + agrupamento, OC with NF but chave_acesso pending (second-chance via webhook), and Ciclo 2 worker detecting existing NF and skipping to stock
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Do not force CLAUDE.md churn just to satisfy the PRD. Update CLAUDE.md only if implementation uncovers genuinely reusable patterns that meet the Ralph instructions.
